meta.name: release-skills
meta.description: Universal release workflow. Auto-detects version files and changelogs. Supports Node.js, Python, Rust, Claude Plugin, GitHub Releases, annotated tags, historical release backfill, and generic projects. Use when user says "release", "发布", "new version", "bump version", "push", "推送", "release notes", "GitHub Release", or "回填 Release".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检测版本文件并生成发布流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发布新版本都要手动改文件、写更新日志
copy.tagline_en: Automatically detect version files and generate release workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually update version files and changelogs for every release

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自动检测项目类型（Node.js、Python、Rust 等），读取版本文件和更新日志，帮你完成版本号升级、生成多语言更新日志、提交代码、打标签，并可选发布到 GitHub Releases。
howto.when: 当你说“发布”、“release”、“new version”、“bump version”、“推送”、“release notes”、“GitHub Release”或“回填 Release”时触发。

say.text: 帮我发布一个新版本，自动检测项目配置。
say.note: Claude 会检测项目类型并询问版本号等确认信息。

say.text: 用 --dry-run 预览发布流程，不实际执行。
say.note: Claude 会展示将要做的更改，但不会真正提交或发布。

say.text: 回填缺失的 GitHub Release，基于已有标签和更新日志。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can auto-detect project type (Node.js, Python, Rust, etc.), read version files and changelogs, bump version, generate multi-language changelogs, commit, tag, and optionally publish to GitHub Releases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "release", "发布", "new version", "bump version", "push", "推送", "release notes", "GitHub Release", or "回填 Release".

say_en.text: Release a new version, auto-detect project config.
say_en.note: Claude will detect project type and ask for confirmation.

say_en.text: Use --dry-run to preview the release process without executing.
say_en.note: Claude will show changes but not commit or publish.

say_en.text: Backfill missing GitHub Releases from existing tags and changelogs.
say_en.note: Claude will create a GitHub Release for each tag.
